LESSON: COMPOSITION OF AIR

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter
Topic 2.2: Composition of Air

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Composition of Air
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does air pollution affect the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the components of air
2. explain the effects of air pollution in the environment
3. describe methods of reducing air pollution in the environment
4. appreciate the need for clean air in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Composition of Air

Teach
• Observe Composition of Air in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Composition of Air (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Composition of Air.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Composition of Air.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Composition of Air.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify the components of air
• explain the effects of air pollution in the environment
• describe methods of reducing air pollution in the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Composition of Air.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Composition of Air: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does air pollution affect the environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the components of air
• explain the effects of air pollution in the environment
• describe methods of reducing air pollution in the environment
• appreciate the need for clean air in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
